[EN] I still don't understand what the mekonaris want with all these victims.

Sikander was supposed to be one of the less worthless gods! Wasn't he in love with Isren?

Blood sacrifice doesn't seem like their thing.
[ES] Sigo sin entender qué quieren los mekonaris con todas estas víctimas.

¡Se supone que Sikander era uno de los dioses menos inútiles! ¿Acaso no estaba enamorado de Isren?

El sacrificio de sangre no parece ser lo suyo.
